props.name: children
props.comment: Custom content in place of the form, the link and the buttons.

props.name: disableEmailPassword
props.comment: Hides the email and password form, its divider and the forgot password link.

props.name: providers
props.comment: OAuth providers to show a button for, in order.

props.name: redirectTo
props.comment: Path a successful sign-in redirects to. Forwarded to `<LoginForm>`.
